name: Kibo UI
summary: Custom shadcn/ui registry of 41 composable components — kanban, gantt, table, dropzone, marquee and more.
description: Kibo UI is a component library and custom registry built on top of shadcn/ui: 41 components from avatar stacks, kanban, gantt, list and table to dropzone, combobox, ticker, announcement and dialog stack, plus blocks. The components use the shadcn/ui CSS variables, wrap headless logic and install with the shadcn CLI. Free and open source, MIT licensed; the repo now lives at github.com/shadcnblocks/kibo.
contains: 41 components: kanban, gantt, table, list, dropzone, combobox, ticker, marquee and more
components use the shadcn/ui CSS variables
installs with the shadcn CLI from the Kibo registry
docs include setup, usage and MCP server pages
